This is consistent with modern Rust packaging practices. The use of `source` to include shared Linux packaging scripts (`packaging/linux/common.sh`) is contained within the fetched source tree and used for metadata and license installation, which is normal. No network operations, file manipulations, or execution of external code occurs outside the build context. All operations are transparent, reproducible, and scoped to the package's legitimate functionality.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, data exfiltration, or execution of unsanctioned scripts. The package adheres to secure AUR packaging standards, with no dangerous commands or suspicious behavior observed.
